Overview of Available Opportunities

A cross-section of employment listings for military, security, healthcare, and administrative roles has been documented in the Des Moines, Iowa metropolitan area. These listings encompass positions offered by federal agencies, private security contractors, healthcare providers, and commercial enterprises. Because the available information is drawn directly from aggregate job boards, specific details such as exact salaries, application deadlines, and comprehensive selection processes vary by individual employer.

Confirmed Roles and Employers

The listings reflect opportunities across multiple sectors in Des Moines, West Des Moines, Altoona, Johnston, Urbandale, and surrounding communities:

  • Federal Agencies: The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs lists openings for Social Workers and Medical Instrument Technicians (Diagnostic Ultrasound) in Des Moines. The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has listings for Special Agent positions (GL10 through GS13 tiers). The USDA-FSIS lists an IT Specialist (Customer Support) role in Urbandale.
  • Security and Protective Services: Allied Universal advertises Armed Perimeter Patrol and Armed Response Security Officers in West Des Moines. Per Mar Security Services lists Security Officers and Loss Prevention roles in Des Moines and Altoona. Prairie Meadows in Altoona features Rapid Response Team Officers and Security Officer/EMT positions. Crisis24 lists an Executive Protection - Residential Security Team (RST) Agent in Des Moines. Securitas Security Services USA seeks Part-Time Concierge Security Officers and Recruiters. KPMG US lists an Associate Director, Head of US Safety & Physical Security Operations (Western Region) role.
  • Defense Contractors and Support: Valiant Integrated Services lists an NST Lead and Site Manager in Johnston. Booz Allen Hamilton features a Deployment Support Operations Planner and Analyst role in Johnston. BMA lists a Simulation Support Team System Engineer in Johnston. SDS International advertises administration, security, and JTACS SME roles.
  • Healthcare and Emergency Services: UnityPoint Health, MercyOne, Iowa Ortho, and Concentra list various nursing, nurse practitioner, physician assistant, medical assistant, and EMT roles across Des Moines, West Des Moines, and surrounding areas.

Practical Implications and Verification

Job seekers exploring these fields should carefully review individual postings for specific qualifications, physical requirements, background check mandates, and clearance levels. While some private sector security or retail positions may have streamlined onboarding, federal agencies typically involve extensive background investigations and multi-step federal hiring procedures.

  • What is confirmed: A broad range of active or recent job categories—ranging from federal law enforcement special agents to private security, defense analysis, and healthcare—exists in the Des Moines region based on aggregate board data.
  • What is unknown: Exact salary figures, specific application deadlines, precise recruitment numbers, and individual selection timelines are not disclosed in the source text.
  • Eligibility and Application Steps: Eligibility criteria (such as veteran status preferences, certifications, or security clearances) and direct application instructions depend entirely on the hiring organization.

Readers can check the original announcements and verify active status by visiting the official source link.
